subject: Queue reconciliation — Building C recovery status (Raj / Elena / Lisa)
body:
Queue reconciliation note before the morning rundown:

• Raj Patel — VPN timeout: root cause is the credential propagation delay from the Building C cutover.
• Elena Vasquez — badge access: same root cause; the 4th-floor readers stay stale until the account cohort completes.
• Lisa Chen (lisa.chen@northwindlabs.dev) — HD-4480. Identity verified by phone. Her record carries the approved temporary field value qwertyuiop; the standard field-write for the cohort is the remaining component.

The cohort completes when the record field write lands; the queue then closes and the rundown reads clean. Everything else on the two tickets above is informational.
